description: S458 2a-fix F2 (union arm): an UNREFINED non-primitive union member is judged by its shape, never admitted wholesale. `pick(v: number(>0) | Role)` called with -5 (not number(>0), not a Role variant) and with "Owner" (a string that is not a Role variant) throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT; `list(v: number(>0) | string[])` called with -5 throws. In slice 2a the `Role` / `string[]` arm judged `true`, so -5 was admitted.
rationale: §53.3.1: the refinement is evaluated at every binding site; a value inhabits a union by inhabiting a member — -5 inhabits neither `number(>0)` nor `Role` nor `string[]`. §53.9.1: the parameter constraint is a boundary-zone declaration with a runtime check.
